 Order
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

3. The applicant vide the present application under Section 439 read with Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeks regular bail in FIR No.0433/2022 dated 09.05.2022 registered under Sections 304B/498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at PS.: Ranhola, Delhi.
4. Issue notice.

Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
She seeks, and is granted, four weeks time to file the Status Report alongwith SCRB Report.
The MLC and/or PMR shall also be filed, if needed.

6. Let the Nominal Roll be also requisitioned from the concerned Jail Superintendant within the aforesaid period of two weeks.
7.
